column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the staging scan (pipeline.yml, staging job).
# Every rule not listed stays WARN, and any warning fails the job, so a new
# finding stops the deploy. Format: rule id<TAB>action<TAB>(reason).

column3: (CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline': the theme tokens are an inline <style> block generated per request from theme.json, and components set runtime style values, so a fixed hash cannot cover them. Scripts stay hash-locked.)
(Content cacheability: informational; pages are server-rendered per request on purpose.)
(Modern web application: informational; the scanner noting the site uses JavaScript.)
